title: MeroSplit
shortDescription: Track shared expenses, split bills and record payments with friends.
fullDescription:
MeroSplit keeps shared bills and balances in one place. Use it with friends, roommates or travel groups. Add an expense, choose who shared it and split it evenly or with custom shares. See who owes whom and record payments made outside the app.

Keep shared expenses clear
• Create groups and keep track of expenses with individual people.
• Split bills evenly or with custom shares.
• See balances and record payments made outside MeroSplit.
• Attach a photo or PDF to a bill.
• Discuss a bill in chat, with report and block controls.
• Preview a Splitwise CSV before importing it.
• Export your records and delete your account from Me.

Recent records stay on your phone for offline use. Saved changes sync when you reconnect. If a change conflicts with a newer record, review it before retrying.

Payments happen outside MeroSplit
MeroSplit does not send, receive or verify money. A supported UPI link can open a separate payment app, where you review and authorize the payment. Recording or acknowledging a payment updates shared records only. MeroSplit does not connect to your bank, convert currencies or read text from receipt images.

Privacy and help
Bill chats are visible to group members and are not end-to-end encrypted. You can report messages and block users in chat. See https://merosplit.com/chat-policy.
